name: Ghall
source:
Ghall – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
An adult dark blue-eyed bearded om'verai with bright horns and various thin spikes all around the head.
Ghall seems to be helpful towards those who needs help, as well as being calm and polite at first sight. However, Ghall is truly a greedy person who can easily ruin the entire carreer of his employees.
